content.title: 'The Boys' season 5 episodes 1 and 2 release date on Prime Video — here's the full schedule
content.text: (Image credit: Prime Video) Brace yourself. The countdown to the end of "The Boys" is officially on. One of Prime Video’s biggest and most talked-about original series is gearing up for its fifth and final season. It's been an excruciating wait, given the way things left off in season 4, so it's a relief to rejoin the supes. Even better, "The Boys season 5" will premiere with the first two episodes.Whether you've been following Billy Butcher, Homelander, and the rest of the show's blood-soaked madness from the beginning or you only recently caught up, you're here for one thing: to find out when the final season actually begins. So let's get into it, and if you're looking for more to watch be sure to check out the 3 new to Prime Video thriller movies to watch this week.'The Boys' season 5 episode 1 and episode 2 release date and timeWondering exactly when you can hang with the craziest superheroes on streaming? We've got all the answers you seek.Article continues below Latest Videos From Tom's Guide"The Boys" season 5 is slated to premiere Wednesday, April 8 on Prime Video.Assuming Amazon sticks to that plan and doesn't opt for an early-release move (similar to its strategy for the first and last episodes of "Fallout" season 2), the first two episodes of "The Boys" season 5 should premiere worldwide on that date.That said, there is still a chance Amazon could make a late change and release them on the evening of April 7 in North and South America. If that happens, the schedule below will obviously change. For now, though, you can count on this data for the expected release times for the show's Prime Video premiere.U.S. — Wednesday, April 8 at 12 a.m. PT / 3 a.m. ETCanada — Wednesday, April 8 at 12 a.m. PT / 3 a.m. ETU.K. — Wednesday, April 8 at 8 a.m. BSTIndia — Wednesday, April 8 at 12:30 p.m. ISTSingapore — Wednesday, April 8 at 3 p.m. SGTAustralia — Wednesday, April 8 at 5 p.m. AEDTNew Zealand — Wednesday, April 8 at 7 p.m. NZDTGet instant access to breaking news, the hottest reviews, great deals and helpful tips.'The Boys' season 5 full episode release schedule The Boys – Final Season Trailer | Prime Video - YouTube Watch On Want to add the final episodes of "The Boys" to your calendar? Here's your full "The Boys" season 5 episode release schedule."The Boys" season 5 episode 1, "Fifteen Inches of Sheer Dynamite" — April 8"The Boys" season 5 episode 2 — April 8"The Boys" season 5 episode 3 — April 15"The Boys" season 5 episode 4 — April 22"The Boys" season 5 episode 5 — April 29"The Boys" season 5 episode 6 — May 6"The Boys" season 5 episode 7 — May 13"The Boys" season 5 episode 8 — May 20How to stream 'The Boys' season 5 for free on Prime VideoIf you're trying to watch new episodes of "The Boys" season 5 for free, you're in luck because there is a way to do it. The series is available on Prime Video, which is included with an Amazon Prime membership. That means you don't need a separate subscription to access it if you already have Amazon Prime.There's also a 30-day free trial available for new Prime subscribers. So, if you're eligible, you can use that trial to stream "The Boys" season 5 without paying upfront.Prime Video also offers a premium tier so you can get ad-free shows and 4K streaming. But you don't need to have those to watch. All you need is a standard Prime membership or an eligible free trial to watch "The Boys" season 5 as soon as it lands. Only a few days away now!'The Boys' season 5 plot detailsSince this is the final season of "The Boys," expect an epic endgame that's bloody and brutal. Here is Prime Video's official synopsis:"In the fifth and final season, it’s Homelander’s world, completely subject to his erratic, egomaniacal whims. Hughie, Mother’s Milk, and Frenchie are imprisoned in a “Freedom Camp.” Annie struggles to mount a resistance against the overwhelming Supe force. Kimiko is nowhere to be found. But when Butcher reappears, ready and willing to use a virus that will wipe all Supes off the map, he sets in motion a chain of events that will forever change the world and everyone in it. It’s the climax, people. Big stuff’s gonna happen." Follow Tom's Guide on Google News and add us as a preferred source to get our up-to-date news, analysis, and reviews in your feeds.
